name: Memory
summary: The whole memory set, grouped. Seven groups and thirty-two memories under a summary of what the assistant has been told, with Search and Select in the bar.

looseEnds.title: Two memories appear in two groups each
looseEnds.detail: “You’re 8 weeks pregnant” is in Top of mind and Sexual & reproductive health; “You’re allergic to penicillin” is in Top of mind and Current symptoms & conditions. Deleting one has to remove both rows, and nothing says whether Top of mind is a view of the others or a group of its own.
looseEnds.ask: Is Top of mind a ranking over the other groups, or a group that holds its own copies?

looseEnds.title: Nothing is drawn for a long list
looseEnds.detail: The content runs to 3097px — roughly four screens. There is no pagination, no section index and no sticky group heading, so a user at the bottom has no way back but scrolling.
looseEnds.ask: Does the list page at some count, or is scrolling the whole answer?
